CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT DeltaFileFormat
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELTA
);

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT ParquetFileFormat
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
);

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT jsonFileFormat
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = JSON
);

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.patientAddress
(
    patient_id varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    address_city varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    address_country varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    address_line varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    address_postalCode varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    address_state varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    address_extension_extension_url varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    address_extension_extension_valueDecimal float,
    address_extension_url varchar(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
)  
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'Patient_address',
    DATA_SOURCE = silver,  
    FILE_FORMAT = DeltaFileFormat
)
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.patientIdentifier
(
    patient_id varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    birthDate varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    deceasedDateTime varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    gender varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    maritalStatus_text varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    maritalStatus_coding_code varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    maritalStatus_coding_display varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    maritalStatus_coding_system varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    multipleBirthBoolean bit,
    multipleBirthInteger bigint,
    resourceType varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    text_div varchar(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    text_status varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    identifier_system varchar(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    identifier_type_coding_code varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    identifier_type_coding_system varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    identifier_type_text varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    identifier_value varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    name_family varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    name_given varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    name_prefix varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    name_suffix varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    name_use varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    telecom_system varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    telecom_use varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    telecom_value varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    communication_language_text varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    communication_language_coding_code varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    communication_language_coding_display varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    communication_language_coding_system varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
)  
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'Patient_identifier',
    DATA_SOURCE = silver,  
    FILE_FORMAT = DeltaFileFormat
)
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.patientExtension
(
    patient_id varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    extension_url varchar(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    extension_valueAddress_city varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    extension_valueAddress_country varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    extension_valueAddress_state varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    extension_valueDecimal float,
    extension_valueString varchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
)  
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'Patient_extension',
    DATA_SOURCE = silver,  
    FILE_FORMAT = DeltaFileFormat
)
GO

-- use CETAS to export select statement with OPENROWSET result to  storage
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.patientIdentifierPersisted
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'materializedViews/PatientIdentifier',
    DATA_SOURCE = silver,  
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFileFormat
)  
AS
select 
    patient_id,
    birthDate,
    deceasedDateTime,
    gender,
    maritalStatus_text,
    maritalStatus_coding_code,
    maritalStatus_coding_display,
    maritalStatus_coding_system,
    multipleBirthBoolean,
    multipleBirthInteger,
    resourceType,
    text_div,
    text_status,
    identifier_system,
    identifier_type_coding_code,
    identifier_type_coding_system,
    identifier_type_text,
    identifier_value,
    name_family,
    name_given,
    name_prefix,
    name_suffix,
    name_use,
    telecom_system,
    telecom_use,
    telecom_value,
    communication_language_text,
    communication_language_coding_code,
    communication_language_coding_display,
    communication_language_coding_system
from
silver.patientIdentifierView

GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.patientAddressPersisted
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'materializedViews/PatientAddress',
    DATA_SOURCE = silver,  
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFileFormat
)  
AS
select 
    patient_id,
    address_city,
    address_country,
    address_line,
    address_postalCode,
    address_state,
    address_extension_extension_url,
    address_extension_extension_valueDecimal,
    address_extension_url
from
silver.patientAddressView;

drop EXTERNAL TABLE silver.patientExtensionPersisted;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.patientExtensionPersisted
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'materializedViews/PatientExtension',
    DATA_SOURCE = silver,  
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFileFormat
)  
AS
select 
    patient_id,
    extension_url,
    extension_valueAddress_city,
    extension_valueAddress_country,
    extension_valueAddress_state,
    extension_valueDecimal,
    extension_valueString
from
silver.patientExtensionView;


CREATE STATISTICS [statPatientIdentifierPersistedPatientId] ON silver.patientIdentifierPersisted(patient_id);
CREATE STATISTICS [statPatientIdentifierPersistedGender] ON silver.patientIdentifierPersisted(gender);
CREATE STATISTICS [statPatientIdentifierPersistedBirthDate] ON silver.patientIdentifierPersisted(birthDate);
